trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the character questlines and the cleanup trophies — and it arrives on its own. There are no online trophies and a single playthrough is enough.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. The trophy pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing past the chapter card. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy — just play through the chapter's missions to its end.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy — just play through the chapter's missions to its end.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — just play through the chapter's missions to its end.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Automatic story trophy. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, and the 100% completion checklist opens up — nothing is locked behind the ending.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide; Push Square trophy guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest trophy on the list. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist — you only need the listed numbers, not everything: story done; 100 optional tasks; 39 gang operations; 22 bank jobs; 7 payday loan jobs; 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs; 50 of 91 stick-ups; all 8 bank vaults; fencing totals of $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills and $200,000 vehicles; 15 of 18 card sets; 100 WAiNK scans; all 33 underwater discoveries; 30 of 34 magazines, books and comics; 15 of 18 meditations; 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos; 2 unique playlists; 70 of 79 styles; 200 of 277 base-model vehicles; 50 of 66 standard weapons; 100 of 255 animals studied; 30 of 40 races won; 10 of 13 race challenge golds; all 42 shooting range golds; all 4 video games played; 5 of 7 pool opponents beaten; mini golf at 2 of 3 courses; 90 of 100 basketball hoops; all 42 drone time trials; 300 of 397 stunts; 70 of 80 challenges; all 15 of Bret's target decks. Check the totals before chasing a category — most can be left partly done.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (100% checklist)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, 397 in total — and any mix counts. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and use the map's Exploration filter to list stunt spots. Note 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide; Push Square trophy guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: catch a fish, hunt, play golf, finish a shooting range course, play pool, sink a basketball shot, play a video game, win a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race all count), and perform a stunt. Check what is left in Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most of these happen naturally while you play.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide; GTABase trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. Work through each range's challenges one at a time and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn the gold thresholds — this is the hardest grind after 100% by several guides' counts, so leave it for cleanup rather than rushing it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; PowerPyx trophy guide; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone time trials in total, but the trophy only needs a win at each location, not every trial. 100% completion needs all 42 trials finished, so the trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; Push Square trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street races, dirt races, motorsport, race challenges and drone races. 100% completion needs 30 of 40 unique races won, so this pops while you work toward that.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types — find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. A better rod and the right bait help, but the challenge is a contest of catches, not gear.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; GTABase trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to its end — any title counts.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia, and follow the strand to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; PowerPyx trophy guide roadmap (Lucia-only questlines)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its end — his treasure hunts also feed the 33 underwater discoveries that 100% completion needs, so do them as you go.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6collectiblesmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Look for the stranger markers on the map and finish eight full strands. The five side-character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) have their own trophies, so count the other strangers toward this one.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, so play it as Jason, and follow the strand to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; PowerPyx trophy guide roadmap (Jason-only questlines)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — the one potentially missable trophy on the list. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, talk to her in the kitchen when she mentions meditating, follow her out to the balcony and accept. That balcony session may not count as a marked spot later, so do it before leaving Chapter 1 and make a manual save. The other spots are marked across Leonida; both Jason and Lucia can meditate at the same spot and each one counts. Whether the balcony session is strictly required is still unconfirmed — do it anyway to avoid any risk.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (missable section)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strands are Jason-only — complete his target decks (all 15 feed 100% completion) and hunt the unique animal he marks for you.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; PowerPyx trophy guide roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 480 cards in 18 themed sets scattered across Leonida — finish any three full sets. 100% completion needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6collectiblesmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags whenever you pass something new — and scan vehicles early too, since 200 base-model vehicles count toward 100% completion.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6collectiblesmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and many complete naturally while you work on other trophies. 100% completion needs 70, so aim past 50 rather than stopping here.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and get clear of the search area together.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hold up three shops in a row — aim at the clerk and empty the till — while your partner is with you, and stay wanted throughout: don't let the heat drop between shops.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6database activities list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicles as you meet them; the WAiNK app logs each new model. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Start Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends — a gang operation or a bank job is a good place to try.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off in it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Grab a Rhino — military sites and high wanted levels draw them out — and fire its cannon in a fight.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Hit one of the 35 smash 'n' grab jewelry stores quietly: avoid the cameras and the guards, get in and out before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6database activities list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... in Chapter 4 — rob any five and get away clean. 100% completion needs all eight.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hold up an armored truck in the open world and get away before the police close in.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6database activities list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk into every region until the map is fully unfogged.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 gang-run operations across Leonida — rob at least one site per gang. 100% completion needs all 39.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6database activities list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players — try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach at sunset. Marked unconfirmed as of 2026-11-20; don't chase guesses, check back once players pin it down.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (method unconfirmed)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still being confirmed by players — the current best account is driving a car through the showroom glass and out the other side. Marked unconfirmed as of 2026-11-20.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (method unconfirmed)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train at the gym — buy a membership and work strength with each character until the stat is maxed.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; gta6database activities list (gym workouts)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks what you do in Leonida, and robberies, crimes and story choices all count — the counter reaches 500 well before the platinum if you just keep playing.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. The unlock method is still unconfirmed by players as of 2026-11-20; the description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. Don't chase guesses — check back once players confirm it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (unconfirmed)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. The unlock method is still unconfirmed by players as of 2026-11-20 ('What the hell just happened?') — it most likely involves witnessing something strange out in the world. Don't chase guesses; check back once players confirm it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (unconfirmed)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by players — a melee drive-by near a bowling alley crowd is the current best guess. Marked unconfirmed as of 2026-11-20.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19 (method being confirmed)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Bank jobs pay out in marked bills — fence them through your contacts until the total hits $250,000. 100% completion also needs $250,000 of marked bills fenced, so this pops on the way.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear across Leonida's shops — the total is cumulative and counts every shop.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are eight purchasable garages, costing $160,000 in total — save up and buy them all.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19; Push Square trophy guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase; KeenGamer trophy guide, 2026-11-19
